summary: Neo-Concept International Group Holdings Ltd, a Hong Kong-based Cayman-incorporated apparel firm listed on Nasdaq (NCI), filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice and proxy for an extraordinary general meeting to be held October 29, 2026. The sole substantive agenda item is a proposed share consolidation (reverse split) at a ratio to be set by the board within a range of two-to-four hundred shares into one, effective no later than December 31, 2026, with fractional shares rounded up. No price, stake, or transaction terms are stated; this is a routine EGM notice, not a special situation. Watch for board-determined ratio and any Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance motive.
